conditions.frozen_condition_check: all 64 rebuilt requests hash-equal and body-equal to the frozen general_model rows; enforced as a pre-call gate
conditions.session_header_note: a per-run uuid4; a provider grouping header, not a credential. Generated once per run and recorded so a provider-side request log can be tied to this run.
conditions.transport_note: curl subprocess. The frozen urllib transport is Cloudflare-rejected (403, code 1010) with the same credential. The x-opencode-session provenance header is a per-run uuid4, not part of the hashed body.

credential.note: the $OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY credential is returned 403 "An active OpenCode Go subscription is required" by the Go route for every model; the subscribed credential in the OpenCode CLI credential store is served normally. Only the source LABEL is recorded. The value reaches curl on stdin via `curl -K -`, so it is in neither argv nor any file.

model.family: DIFFERENT family from Jev and from the corpus author (findings.md §4 L1). This run is the cross-family test Q1 calls for; followup-01 was disqualified as same-family.
model.provider: OpenCode Go model, served on the OpenCode Go route
model.route_note: the operator-stated Go route. The Zen route the frozen general_model used does not host this model (400 Model is unavailable), so the route change is forced by the model, not chosen.
